section: Red flags / Criticism in art media

after: Red flags and CRITICISM heading removed; OCCRP (4 Dec 2015), Hyperallergic Jamgochian (28 Feb 2021), The Art Newspaper Sansom (30 Oct 2020) and Batycka (2 Nov 2020) moved to WIDER CONTEXT with dates and attribution, ending with the connection (Mahmudova founded YARAT and has directed the museum since 2012, Wikipedia). Absence lines, unverified figures cut. Overview wording corrected to Wikipedia (about 800 works wording, Sadigzade, Mahmudova attributed to the Aida Mahmudova page). BOTTOM LINE rewritten.
reason: OCCRP, Hyperallergic and The Art Newspaper opened: none names the museum; Wikipedia states the foundation funded the museum; Mahmudova link is on her Wikipedia page, not the museum page.
